requirements: R1: The backend MaterialEntity and Service must persist taxonomy fields (category and tags)

slices.title: Patch MaterialEntity and Service for Cataloging Persistence
slices.jtbd: When implementing Material Cataloging Persistence for this epic, I want to modify the existing MaterialEntity and Service to capture taxonomy fields, so that category and tags are persisted in the database.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a material with category and tags,
When the material is submitted,
Then the backend successfully persists these fields in the database.
Given automated tests,
When the test suite is executed,
Then it successfully verifies the persistence of the taxonomy fields.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase cataloging metadata persistence rate from 0% to 100%

requirements: R1: The /api/materials endpoints must restrict POST, PUT, and DELETE operations to authenticated users

slices.title: Patch Material Endpoints to Enforce Authentication
slices.jtbd: When implementing Material Management Access Control for this epic, I want to secure the write endpoints, so that unauthenticated actors cannot corrupt epidemiological records.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated request,
When attempting to POST, PUT, or DELETE to /api/materials,
Then the server responds with 401 Unauthorized.
Given the security test suite (e.g. *Test.java),
When tests are run,
Then negative error states for 401 Unauthorized are explicitly verified.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized material modification rate from 100% to 0%
